subject.title: feat: add codexbar guard — quota-aware exit code to gate automation

question: What permanent provider-window and exit-code contract should `codexbar guard` expose to scripts?
rationale: The branch creates a new public automation API whose provider scope, lane naming, defaults, and fail-open behavior cannot be safely chosen from implementation evidence alone.

options.title: Narrow descriptor-backed v1
options.body: Support only validated provider windows through descriptor-backed capabilities or labels, document the exact contract, and require configured-account proof before merge.

options.title: Use primary/secondary terminology
options.body: Keep broad provider support but expose generic primary/secondary window identifiers instead of promising session/weekly semantics.

options.title: Decline the command
options.body: Keep CodexBar as a reporting surface and close this PR plus the paired proposal if quota gating is outside the intended CLI product.

recommendation.title: Narrow descriptor-backed v1
recommendation.body: Support only validated provider windows through descriptor-backed capabilities or labels, document the exact contract, and require configured-account proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner merged the recent comparable CLI command and was directly asked to decide this feature’s contract.
